full_name: Julie Orringer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Fiction & Poetry Lisa Goldberg Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Julie Orringer is the author of The Invisible Bridge (Knopf, 2010), a novel set in Europe during the Second World War, and How to Breathe Underwater (Knopf, 2003), a collection of short stories.
